newsitem.title: ITALY: Thieves steal statue from St Mark's in Venice.
newsitem.headline: Thieves steal statue from St Mark's in Venice.

text.p: Thieves have stolen a small bronze statue of a lion, the symbol of Venice, from St Mark's Basilica in the lagoon city.
Police on Tuesday said the statue, which dates from 1615, had been wrenched from a marble pedestal in a side chapel, possibly with a crowbar.
The statue, the work of artist Gabriel Orlandini, was noticed missing by a church warder on Monday and the theft reported to police.
The Italian news agency ANSA said the theft may have occurred during the main Sunday mass in the basilica.
Thieves stole precious jewels adorning an image of the Madonna from St Mark's in 1979. The gems were later found.
